theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T T' S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (y : Euclid P) (ρ ρ' : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < n → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T' → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsIntegerMultiplicity R → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω - T' ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) → 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ' → closedBall y ρ' ⊆ U → ∃ (t : ℝ) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (RY : IMRep U n), ρ < t ∧ t < ρ' ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity X ∧ BoundaryVanishes X ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (closedBall y t) → X ω = 0) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = T' ω + X ω) ∧ RY.Represents Y ∧ RY.measure (closedBall y t) ≤ T.massOn (ball y ρ') + S.massOn (ball y ρ') + ENNReal.ofReal (2 / (ρ' - ρ)) * R.massOn (ball y ρ')
